table.searchPlaceholder: Order ID, refund reference, transfer content, customer phone or name...

empty.REQUESTED: Nothing is waiting to be refunded.

complete.title: Confirm the refund transfer
complete.warning: Transfer the money to the customer with your banking app first, then confirm here. The system does not move money by itself.

reference.label: Bank transaction reference
reference.info: Reference of the refund transfer, up to 64 characters, not used by another refund.

note.label: Note
note.info: Required. For example: sent back to the original account at 14:05. The customer does not see this note.

reject.title: Reject refund
reject.warning: Order #{id} will not be refunded {amount}. The customer will see that the store does not refund and is asked to contact the store.

note.label: Reason
note.info: Required, kept for later checks. The customer does not see this reason.

banner.title: Order cancelled but not refunded
banner.waiting: A refund request is waiting for the shop to transfer the money back to the customer.
banner.missing: This order has no refund request waiting.

pending.title: {count, plural, one {# refund waiting for a transfer} other {# refunds waiting for a transfer}}
pending.includes: The system does not move money itself: each one is money to give back to the customer after an order was cancelled or items were returned.
pending.how: Transfer the money with your banking app, then click "Transferred" and enter the bank reference. If you will not refund, click "Reject" and give the reason.
